g.text: Forward-facing folding seat · open, moving and stowed geometry
C3 R0 · 19 OCT 2026 · INCHES UNLESS MARKED · PRELIMINARY — NOT FOR FABRICATION
One passenger place; wheelchair bay is unavailable.
Crew operation only. Hold the moving seat; pins
Wheelchair bay available after both locks are
Hinge: X64.000, Z48.500; axis parallel to Y.
FOLD2 repeats the entire module at +66.000 in along X.
Downward seat load bears on two hard stops, one at each side.
Separate lock pins engage at 0° and 90°; withdrawn during rotation.
Nominal clearance is geometric, without coating, wear or weld distortion.
Handholds, controlled lifting, guards and final pin retention remain open.
All three projections use the same canonical solids transformed about the same hinge axis; hidden edges are shown without removal.
A clear rectangle in the plan is not proof of wheelchair access. Validate an occupied device, feet, securement and the neighboring occupied bay.
The complete folded package must remain inside its 6-inch strip, including covers, handles and final fasteners. Allowance is not a finished tolerance.
Convert only while stationary and unoccupied. Lifting assistance, positive anti-release retention, pinch protection and service instructions are unfinished.
